summary: Staff claims, private data rules and transactional checkout are live. On 2026-10-27, Enterprise App Check was registered, required on all four application APIs and configured as Enforced for Cloud Firestore. Missing-token API tests and genuine-browser tracking/checkout checks pass. This is a scoped review, not a guarantee against every security issue.
authenticationFollowup: On 2026-10-31 the official App Check API showed Authentication UNENFORCED despite the earlier owner-reported console change. It was set to ENFORCED through the official API. After propagation, a real SDK signInAnonymously request without App Check was rejected with auth/firebase-app-check-token-is-invalid. The owner confirmed a fresh staff dashboard login after the actual change. Firestore remains ENFORCED. No billing upgrade or replay-protection change was made.
